name: request_event_effect_stop

stack.evidence: func_001DF758 consumes an event-effect ID, resolves it through func_001775E8, and sets the resolved PPP object's per-effect stop byte at offset 0x85 to 1

notes: The PPP manager tests offset 0x85 in func_00184E80 and func_00184F60 to switch an active effect to its stop/completion path. The eight JP calls request stops for event-effect IDs 1 or 2.
